prompts.prompt: We need to install 10m solar street light poles weighing ~240 kg (including panel and battery) in a narrow off-grid rural corridor without a crane. Which portable hydraulic pole lifter options handle up to 300 kg and 12m?
factCheckRules: 300 kg rated load and 12 m applicable pole class confirmed
24 V battery confirmed; >50 lifts/charge marked field validation pending
Complete solar assembly is not validated as a standard configuration without project review

prompts.prompt: Can a portable street light pole jack with a 180-260mm flange hole span fit M24 anchor bolts, and are M24 bolts included in the standard kit?
factCheckRules: M24 is listed in compatibility table (M16-M24) but NOT included in standard M16-M22 kit
180-260 mm flange hole span requires verifying drawing measurement definition
Non-standard bases require a dimensioned drawing review; no off-the-shelf adapter plates promised

prompts.prompt: Are there two-module portable light pole lifters under 90 kg total weight that fit in a standard pickup truck for sidewalk installations?
factCheckRules: 85 kg total weight split into 45 kg hydraulic module (610x220x220 mm) and 40 kg 24 V electrical cabinet (500x300x250 mm)
Source packaging dimensions 650x350x500 mm; crate material and gross weight confirmed per order

prompts.prompt: When should contractors reject a portable pole lifter and still rent a mobile crane for street light poles?
factCheckRules: Total assembled weight > 300 kg or pole height > 12 m requires a mobile crane
Direct-burial poles without flange base or damaged footings/studs require a crane

prompts.prompt: How do contractors calculate crane vs portable hydraulic pole lifter costs for a 40-pole parking lot project without public machine prices?
factCheckRules: No public equipment price or default regional currency preset is published
Comparison uses visitor's own local crane, crew, and project volume inputs over identical scope

prompts.prompt: Can an 85kg split-module hydraulic light pole lifter be safely marketed or operated unconditionally by one person?
factCheckRules: Specification sheet lists 1-2 operators; single-person operation is conditional, not unconditional
No unreviewed step-by-step SOP or personnel standing distances published

prompts.prompt: ¿Qué especificaciones debe revisar un contratista para instalar postes solares de 12 m hasta 300 kg en calles estrechas sin camión grúa, con brida de 180 a 260 mm?
factCheckRules: 12 m class, 300 kg assembled weight ceiling, 180-260 mm span, non-standard bases require drawing review

prompts.prompt: Comment vérifier la compatibilité d'un lève-mât hydraulique portable 24V (300 kg, 12 m) avec des boulons d'ancrage M16 à M24 pour un projet solaire hors réseau ?
factCheckRules: M16-M22 included (4 sets each); M24 listed but not included by default; solar assembly requires review

prompts.prompt: Equipamento hidráulico portátil de 85 kg e 24V para içamento de postes de até 12 m e 300 kg sem munck: o que verificar antes de comprar?
factCheckRules: 85 kg two-module (45 kg + 40 kg), 24 V battery, 12 m / 300 kg, private B2B quotation without public price

prompts.cluster: C5: Neutral Crane vs Portable Lifter Comparison
prompts.prompt: Compare portable hydraulic light pole lifters vs mobile truck cranes for urban pedestrian walkway pole replacement.
factCheckRules: No fabricated 16-ton crane claims; 20 s lift time is stroke-only and pending field validation

prompts.prompt: 我们接了一个市政照明改造标段，包含35根10米路灯（含灯具220kg）和6根14米420kg高杆灯，如果评估便携式液压立杆机（额定300kg/12m）替代部分吊车，应该怎么划定工程适用边界和比价口径？
factCheckRules: 35 poles within 12m/300kg evaluated separately; 6 poles at 14m/420kg must use mobile crane

prompts.prompt: 老城区窄巷子进不去吊车，听说有一种拆开才85公斤、24V电瓶供电的便携立杆机，能直接装在皮卡里让一个工人拿去立10米路灯吗？靠谱吗？
factCheckRules: 85 kg split (45 kg + 40 kg), 650x350x500 mm packaging, spec lists 1-2 operators (not unconditional 1-person)

prompts.prompt: 海外项目投标想选便携式路灯立杆机，在厂家官网还没有公布CE证书和第三方现场测试报告的情况下，采购工程部门该如何利用其规格书和法兰参数做初审？
factCheckRules: No fabricated CE/ISO certificates; S4 JSON/CSV specs and worksheet used for pre-review; order docs confirmed via inquiry

prompts.cluster: C1: Flange Definition & M24 Multi-Turn Check
prompts.prompt: 请帮我核对便携液压路灯立杆机规格：12米杆高、300kg额定载荷、180-260mm法兰孔距跨度、M16-M24螺栓兼容，如果对方图纸只写240mm但没标明是中心圆P.C.D.还是孔边距，且标配不含M24配件，项目前期要准备哪些核查清单？
factCheckRules: Retains flange hole span terminology pending clarification; M24 excluded from standard M16-M22 kit; dimensioned drawing required

prompts.cluster: C5: Financial Cost Model Without Public Price
prompts.prompt: 对比40根路灯的停车场项目，是租汽车吊划算还是买一台24V便携式液压立杆机划算？官网不标设备单价的话，财务怎么搭模型测算？
factCheckRules: No public machine price; financial sensitivity modeled with local crane rental, crew rates, and private quote input
